source_name: СМАРТ/МК: Дигитална Македонија 2030 (draft national digital strategy, June 2025)
why_relevant: The current-generation national digital strategy draft succeeding the 2023-2027 ICT strategy; expected to define digital-payment, digital-ID and e-government priorities to 2030 and therefore the medium-term procurement pipeline.

source_name: Национална ИКТ Стратегија 2023-2027 (MDT-hosted PDF)
why_relevant: Four-pillar national ICT strategy including digital government and business digitalisation — baseline document for judging whether current payment/fiscalisation programmes are on plan.

entity_name: National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia
source_name: NBRNM — CaSys / International Card System AD system description page
why_relevant: Regulator's own description of CaSys as a multilateral deferred net settlement system for domestic-brand payment cards — the authoritative statement of the domestic card scheme/settlement arrangement (the closest thing MK has to a national card scheme).

entity_name: National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia
source_name: NBRNM — Crypto-assets Q&A / regulatory position
why_relevant: Central bank's stated position on crypto-assets — determines whether crypto/e-money startups can legally operate or partner with MK banks.

entity_name: National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia
source_name: NBRSM — Финтек-стратегија за финансиски регулатори 2023-2027 (FinTech Strategy for Financial Regulators)
why_relevant: Joint regulators' fintech strategy setting the 2023-2027 agenda (innovation hub/sandbox, open banking, digital payments). Names the initiatives that create vendor demand and the inter-regulator partnerships shaping the payments market.

entity_name: National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia
source_name: Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems (ЗПУПС) — consolidated text (NBRNM PDF)
why_relevant: Defines the licensing regime for payment system operators, PIs and EMIs, the statutory registers, and the obligations (incl. instant payments) that drive infrastructure procurement — the legal backbone explaining why KIBS obtained an instant-payments operator licence in 2025.

source_name: Bank remittance-partner disclosure documents (e.g. Stopanska Banka Western Union general offer)
why_relevant: Bank T&C/offer PDFs name the remittance brand each bank represents as agent and the payment-initiation role it plays — a reliable way to reconstruct the remittance-operator/bank partnership map.

source_name: MASIT — специјализиран настан: СЕПА трансфери, национални капацитети и патот кон интеграција
why_relevant: A single-topic MK event on SEPA integration — exactly the procurement wave payments vendors chase. Speaker list identifies bank and regulator people driving SEPA readiness.

source_name: Digital Bridge & Business ICT Forum (MASIT–SETPE) event series
why_relevant: Concrete example of association-brokered cross-border partnership (MoU between MASIT and the Greek ICT federation SETPE) with B2B matchmaking — exactly the partnership-formation signal this cell exists to catch; participant/partner lists are collectable.

source_name: INREKOM study 'Електронско банкарство: Дигитална трансформација во Македонија' (PDF)
why_relevant: A Macedonian-language sector study of e-banking digital transformation that recurs as a top result for both vendor and bank queries; the kind of document that names platforms, suppliers and adoption state per bank. Baseline (2020) rather than current, so useful as a historical anchor for vendor incumbency.

source_name: World Bank ECA brief — Advancing Modernization and Integration of Payment Systems in the Western Balkans
why_relevant: Programme-level page for the regional payment-modernization workstream that MK participates in; identifies the reform agenda that will generate future donor-funded payment-infrastructure procurement, plus named counterpart institutions.

source_name: World Bank Documents & Reports — North Macedonia Procurement Plans (STEP-generated)
why_relevant: Procurement Plans list every planned package with description, estimated value, method and market approach BEFORE tendering — a forward pipeline view. P176366 'Building Effective, Transparent and Accountable Public Financial Management Institutions' (MoF) is directly on-topic for public financial infrastructure and IT.

source_name: World Bank corporate procurement - 'Electronic payments in North Macedonia' RFx
why_relevant: A live procurement notice revealing that the World Bank with the National Bank is assessing the electronic-payments-acceptance landscape in MK - names the workstream, scope and timing, and signals a forthcoming public diagnostic plus consultant ecosystem around MK acquiring/POS.

source_name: Комерцијална банка АД Скопје — awards & investor presentations (Global Finance, The Banker)
why_relevant: Bank self-reporting of international awards (Global Finance 'Best Bank in Macedonia 2025'; The Banker 'Bank of the Year' multiple times) is a dated recognition trail; presentations also list digital initiatives and partners behind them.

source_name: Macedonian Stock Exchange (МСЕ) news — EBRD-funded market-financing project
why_relevant: Concrete, dated example of a donor-funded MK financial-infrastructure assignment where the implementing consultants are named (PwC North Macedonia and PwC Croatia) — exactly the competitor-identification signal this cell exists to catch, and it appeared in the local press/issuer channel rather than in a tender index.

source_name: eCommerce4all.mk — e-payment guide module
why_relevant: Donor/association-produced practitioner guide that names the local processor (CaSys/cPay), lists which MK banks do acquiring, and gives merchant onboarding costs — rare explicit mapping of the acquiring landscape.

source_name: Ecommerce4all.mk — E-payment guide (MK/EN)
why_relevant: Bilingual practitioner guide that enumerates which MK banks offer e-commerce acquiring (Stopanska, NLB, Komercijalna among them) and how the payment chain is wired locally — a rare consolidated view of bank-side payment capability and intermediaries.

source_name: MKJOB — AI job-search platform for North Macedonia (launch covered by Bankarstvo)
why_relevant: Newly launched MK AI job-matching platform; new aggregators re-index ads that expire elsewhere and may expose structured skill fields, so it is worth evaluating as an additional harvesting surface. Canonical product URL not yet confirmed.

source_name: EU4Digital Facility (regional IPA/Enlargement digital programme covering North Macedonia)
why_relevant: Regional EU-funded facility whose Phase III explicitly lists North Macedonia among beneficiary countries in Macro-Economy & Public Finance and ICT sectors; regional lots are a common route by which international consultancies enter MK digital-finance work without a MK-specific tender ever being issued.

source_name: Nextsense — banking news / customer announcements (Komercijalna Banka digital onboarding platform)
why_relevant: Skopje-headquartered vendor publishing a named win at Komercijalna Banka AD Skopje (remote account opening, e-banking activation, debit card issuance). Direct evidence of who supplies MK digital-channel/onboarding stacks.

source_name: cPay integration plugin listings (Holest, Vendor eCommerce and similar integrator blogs)
why_relevant: Third-party integrator docs expose cPay's technical interface, onboarding steps and fees — reveals gateway adoption among MK webshops and which platforms dominate.

source_name: Entrust — press release: card digitization / push provisioning to Google Pay for Komercijalna Banka AD Skopje
why_relevant: Named MK bank win by a global issuance/tokenization vendor (Entrust issuer TSP hub + Digital Card Solution SDK inside the mBanka app). Shows which international card-tech vendors already sell into MK.

source_name: Exclusive Networks Adriatics — distributor partnership announcements
why_relevant: Value-added distributors publish new-partnership notices that reveal which MK software houses have joined which regional reseller channel and for which product lines — the distribution layer between foreign vendors and MK banks that neither party advertises directly.

source_name: Interoperable Europe Portal / OSOR - North Macedonia country report
why_relevant: EC-hosted annual country report on MK digital-government, interoperability and e-ID/e-services infrastructure - the public-sector rails (identity, e-payment of public fees) that bank and payment vendors integrate with.

source_name: Interworks (Битола) — MK software house profile via Inovativnost.mk
why_relevant: Extends the actor map beyond Skopje: Interworks is a Bitola-based MK company delivering to large international business clients. Inovativnost.mk profiles MK tech firms in Macedonian and is a useful discovery channel for second-tier integrators that might carry finance references.

source_name: National Digital ID programme coverage (Mastercard newsroom, Evrotrust, Biometric Update)
why_relevant: Documents the state's digital identity partnership (national digital ID with Mastercard, operated by Evrotrust) and the digital ID wallet / mDL connected to the government services portal — a concrete case of a state mandate forcing a vendor selection in the identity-and-payments stack.

source_name: NBRSM international research conference series (SUERF co-hosted central banking conferences, Skopje)
why_relevant: The National Bank co-hosts international conferences in Skopje (e.g. with SUERF) on central banking, innovation and resilience. Programmes name senior regulators and international speakers — useful for regulatory-direction signals that precede bank IT spend.

source_name: Open Government Partnership — North Macedonia registry/beneficial-ownership commitments (MK0122, MK0144, MK0185)
why_relevant: Tracks the policy pipeline that determines future accessibility of this cell's core data: free public access to CRM basic data, and publication of beneficial owners (initially for public-procurement winners). Tells the collection plan when a paywalled source is about to open.

entity_name: Registration-agent / law-firm guidance on подружница и претставништво на странско друштво
source_name: Registration-agent / law-firm guidance on подружница и претставништво на странско друштво
why_relevant: Explains the legal mechanics this cell depends on: a foreign company may open an MK branch only if registered at home; branch registration goes through CRM via an authorised registration agent; a branch must publish its annual account and audit report, while a претставништво (representative office) is not a legal entity and may not trade. That distinction determines whether a foreign vendor's MK presence produces registry financials at all.

source_name: Small World FS blog — North Macedonia payments/SEPA commentary
why_relevant: A remittance operator publicly commenting on MK's payments reform and SEPA alignment — reveals how cross-border remittance players read the MK market.

entity_name: Toptal / freelancer marketplace resumes for Skopje developers
source_name: Toptal / freelancer marketplace resumes for Skopje developers
why_relevant: Publicly published CVs outside LinkedIn's login wall; the one found names Oracle FLEXCUBE migration work and cross-check reporting in a Macedonian banking context — proof that marketplace resumes leak incumbent core-banking products.

source_name: US Commercial Service — North Macedonia Country Commercial Guide, 'Selling to the Public Sector'
why_relevant: Concise official orientation to how MK public and donor-funded procurement actually works (PPB/ESPP registration requirements, IFI channels), useful for calibrating collection design and for identifying which channel a given contract will surface in.

source_name: Германско-македонска конференција за контролинг (German-Macedonian Controlling Conference)
why_relevant: A recurring bilateral MK business conference with explicit thematic panels on banking and telecoms plus AI/digitalisation. Secondary for vendor rosters but useful for identifying bank CFO/controlling-side decision makers who appear on panels.
